stories.title: Shotton’s Dee Park Community Woodland awarded Green Flag for first time
stories.summary: Dee Park Community Woodland in Shotton has won its first Green Flag Award. stories.title: North Wales Police stop 40 vehicles in food delivery driver crackdown
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped around 40 vehicles in a crackdown on food delivery drivers. The operation ran on Friday night as part of the force’s Roads Crime Unit enforcement activity. Nine drivers were reported for having no insurance. Seven vehicles were seized. One driver was reported for driving otherwise than in accordance with a licence.

stories.title: Over half of Wales GPs say they cannot meet patient demand, BMA survey finds
stories.summary: More than half of GPs in Wales say they routinely cannot meet patient demand, according to a survey by the British Medical Association. The BMA Cymru Wales Workforce, Workload and Wellbeing Survey, which has run since 2023, took responses from 221 GPs across Wales. 54% of those surveyed described patient access as routinely inadequate.
